The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Refined. Rugged. Engineered to outperform.

The Ferris ISX800 series redefines commercial mowing with advanced technology, enhanced comfort, and serious cutting performance. Designed for professional contractors and serious property owners, the ISX800 delivers smooth control, power, and reliability—mile after mile.

The new Ferris ISX800-60, E OX is equipped with a 60” iCD™ fabricated cutting deck and the industry-leading ForeFront™ Suspension System for unmatched comfort and control. Powered by a fuel-efficient Vanguard® 810 EFI engine with the Oil Guard System, this mower minimizes downtime and maximizes productivity in tough mowing conditions.

Features may include:

Advanced Power
25.5 HP Vanguard® 810 EFI engine with Oil Guard System extends oil change intervals and improves overall efficiency.

ForeFront™ Suspension System
Exclusive suspension system with front control arms and coil-over shocks for superior ride quality and traction.

60″ Fabricated Cutting Deck
Heavy-duty iCD™ Cutting System enhances airflow, cut precision, and long-lasting durability.

Commercial Drive System
Dual Hydro-Gear® ZT-3400® transaxles provide smooth, responsive operation under heavy load.

Quick-Adjust Cutting Height
Adjustable deck height from 1.5” to 5.0” in 1/4” increments for precise mowing control.

Premium Comfort Features
Deluxe high-back suspension seat with armrests, ergonomic controls, and vibration-reducing floor mat for all-day comfort.

Oil Guard System
Exclusive Vanguard® feature extends oil change intervals up to 500 hours, reducing maintenance time and costs.

Productivity Focused
Designed for commercial applications, this machine delivers long-term performance with reduced downtime.
